# The Necronomicon
[color=#999999][italic]"Join us..."[/italic][/color]
As the shift starts, an old tape recorder somewhere aboard finishes reading from the Book of the Dead. Something answers: a [color=#a01818]Kandarian Demon[/color], bound to the [color=#a01818]Necronomicon[/color].
## For the crew - [bold]The book is the demon's anchor.[/bold] It can only be destroyed by [color=orange]fire[/color]. Light it with a lighter, welder or anything hot, and keep it burning for about twenty seconds. - [bold]Hold onto it.[/bold] While a living, unpossessed person carries the book (in hand, a pocket or a bag), it [italic]cannot[/italic] vanish back into the ether. - [bold]Anyone could be a Deadite.[/bold] They look completely normal until they reveal themselves. Then their skin goes corpse-pale, their eyes turn milky white and they start screaming. - Deadites don't stay down. Beat one into critical and it gets back up shortly after. A heavy slash while it's down severs its head, which stops it for good. Burning the book ends them all. - [bold]Mindshields[/bold] protect against possession, until a revealed Deadite reads the passage that melts them away.
## For the demon - You start [bold]incorporeal[/bold]: invisible to the living, untouchable and unable to touch anything. - [bold]Soul Power[/bold] comes from fear: monsters near the crew, monsters speaking, attacks, witnesses and supernatural events. Spend it in the [bold]Skill Store[/bold]. - [bold]Manifest Necronomicon[/bold] puts the book in the world where you stand. Possession needs the book within about 8 tiles of the victim. - [bold]JOIN US[/bold] prepares a victim (a Deadite bite does too). [bold]Possess[/bold] then turns them into a disguised Deadite and uses a charge. You start with two. - [bold]Demonic Possession[/bold] is harmless: the victim collapses and your words come out of their mouth. With [bold]Speak to the Station[/bold], your next sentence becomes an announcement in their name. - [bold]Physical Form[/bold] lets you fight in a body of your chosen shape. If it dies, you return to the ether. - Your HUD shows your Soul Power, your charges and where your book is. Talk privately with other Kandarian entities using [bold]:k[/bold] (Ancient Sumerian).
## Victory The Necronomicon wins when no living soul remains aboard. The crew wins by burning the book.
